topic: check and top off a car's engine oil
core_question: How do I check my car's engine oil level and add more if it's low? (secondary: How do you fix wifi that's running slow or disconnecting frequently?)
answer_summary: With the engine off and cool, pull the dipstick, wipe it, reinsert and pull again to read the level against the min/max marks, then pour the correct-grade oil through the oil fill cap if below the minimum mark.; after the topic shift: Unplug the router (and modem) from power, wait about 30 seconds, then plug it back in and let it fully reboot; this clears temporary glitches and often restores normal wifi speed and connection stability.
persona: anxious and rambling; writing terse one-liners
